In case of a TCP socket connection the SoAd shall call the upper layer with the configured transmit confirmation function ( <Up>[SoAd][If]Tx- Confirmation ()) with result set to E_OK within the SoAd_TxConfirmation () call- back function after all PDU data (from one or multiple transmit requests) have been confirmed for transmission.
